export_pytorch_to_caffe2: export a PyTorch model to Caffe2 init and predict net protobuf files using InitPredictNetExporter
get_exporter_by_type: get a model exporter class by ExporterType name using the get_exporter factory function
save_caffe2_pb_net: save a Caffe2 protobuf net model to a file path using save_caffe2_pb_net
get_dense_feature_metadata: get feature metadata for dense and non-dense features using DenseFeatureExporter get_feature_metadata
get_export_paths: get the init_net.pb and predict_net.pb file paths for a given export directory
